title: Codex quota report
admission: New work permitted by advisory check
healthy: Fresh reading above the alert threshold
low_quota: Quota at or below reserve plus buffer
out_of_order: Reading order is inconsistent; a fresh valid read is required
stale_reason: Reading expired or clock moved backward
reset_requires_read: Reset time passed; a new read is required
notification_requires_read: Account or quota update invalidated the reading
transport_or_auth_error: Connection or authentication unavailable; use the normal approval/sign-in flow
simulation_only: Synthetic replay only; never permits real work
stop_requested: Stop requested; verify the monitor process has exited
no_active_monitor: No active monitor found in this state directory
configuration_or_io_error: Invalid configuration or state access failure; do not bypass permissions
cleanup_or_state_error: Cleanup or state write failed; do not rely on cached permission
pending_unknown: Interrupt outcome unknown; no automatic retry
interrupt_acknowledged: Interrupt request acknowledged; task completion is not confirmed
advisory: Advisory only: no guaranteed quota reserve or control over arbitrary cloud tasks. Invalid or stale values are not a current balance.
confirmation_target_reached: Task target reached; new work blocked, but task pause is not confirmed.
confirmation_events: Pending host events (not proof the user was notified)
reset_planned: Reset planned: a plan, not completion.
reset_completed: Reset completion reported: check your own account separately.
reset_banked: Banked reset announced: receipt and manual redemption are unconfirmed.
reset_manual_credit: Manual credit announced: check the original conditions; no automatic credit or redemption.
reset_advisory: Public announcements do not confirm your personal quota. Never automatically resume or pause work.
reset_third_party: Third-party report; provider verification claims are not independent confirmation or an official API.
reset_baseline: Initial baseline saved; historical announcements suppressed.
reset_ok: Fetch succeeded; only new eligible announcement states are emitted. This is not a no-reset verdict.
reset_network_error: Public source unavailable due to a network/HTTP failure; reset state unknown.
reset_stale: Fetch/check evidence expired; reset state unknown.
reset_parse_error: Provider format or dates invalid; reset state unknown.
reset_source_error: Source identity or original-post link invalid; reset state unknown.
reset_rate_limited: Source rate limited; retry is delayed. Reset state unknown.
reset_waiting: Persistent cooldown active; no network request made. No new evidence.
reset_clock_error: Clock moved backward; polling blocked until the clock recovers.
reset_state_error: Announcement state invalid or full; inspect local state without bypassing permissions.
reset_configuration_error: Invalid public-watch configuration or local state access failure.
reset_stop_requested: Public-watch stop requested; verify the original process has exited.
reset_stopped: Public watch stopped; research tasks are unaffected.
reset_cached: Cached report only; not a fresh poll or proof of a running monitor.
reset_synthetic: Offline synthetic fixture; not live evidence.
reset_help: Optional anonymous public Tibo announcement watch; independent of account quota.
reset_limits: Foreground only. Sleep, exit and network/provider delays can interrupt monitoring. No real-time guarantee or automatic task control.
reset_action_help: read: one poll; start: foreground watch; stop: cooperative request; status: cached report
reset_state_help: Private state parent; uses a separate public-reset-watch subdirectory
reset_provider_help: modelyard: fixed public RSS; alternate providers require code integration and source review
reset_interval_help: Poll seconds, 3600..86400 (default: 3600); persistent cooldown and bounded backoff
reset_age_help: Maximum cached-fetch/check age in seconds (default: 172800); this does not measure source coverage
reset_event_age_help: Maximum new-post age in seconds (default: 604800); late historical posts are suppressed
reset_timeout_help: Shared snapshot timeout, 1..30 seconds (default: 10); at most one extra socket timeout
reset_timezone_help: IANA display timezone (default: UTC); persisted event dates stay UTC
reset_format_help: json: stable machine fields (default); text: localized human report
reset_locale_help: Language en/zh/ru/ja/ko/es/fr/de/pt; unsupported locales fall back to English
reset_fixture_help: Offline version-1 JSON file; read only; isolated synthetic state
reset_source_latest_published_at: Latest publication carried by the feed
reset_coverage_unknown: Source coverage and synchronization are unknown. A successful fetch does not prove the feed includes every announcement.
reset_aggregation_update: Aggregator status update observed locally; this is not a new original post or a verified modification time.
reset_first_observed_status_at: First local observation of this state
reset_scope_unknown: The original text supplied by the aggregator does not establish product scope; its title/context is only a provider claim.
